### Agenus to Participate in Upcoming September Investor Conferences


August 31, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s202.q4cdn.com/949764554/files/doc_news/Agenus-to-Participate-in-Upcoming-September-Investor-Conferences-2026.pdf)


LEXINGTON, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Agenus](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.agenusbio.com&esheet=54591903&newsitemid=20260831875608&lan=en-US&anchor=Agenus&index=1&md5=5e01f4557cb4f912b3ab456da622c7c8) **Inc. (Nasdaq: AGEN)** , a leader in immuno-oncology innovation, today announced that Robin Taylor, Ph.D., Chief Commercial Officer, and Zack Armen, Head of Corporate Development and Investor Relations, will participate in fireside chats and one-on-one investor meetings at two upcoming investor conferences in September.


- **Cantor Global Healthcare Conference 2026** September 9 -11, 2026; New York, NY
Fireside Chat: Tuesday, September 8, 2026 | 11:30 a.m-12:00 p.m. ET


- **H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference** September 14-16, 2026; New York, NY
Fireside Chat: Monday, September 14, 2026 | 3:00 p.m.-3:30 p.m. ET


An archived recording of the fireside chats will be available for 90 days following each event on the Events & Presentations section of the Agenus investor relations website at[Agenus Inc. - Events](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.agenusbio.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54591903&newsitemid=20260831875608&lan=en-US&anchor=Agenus+Inc.+-+Events&index=2&md5=c264a8fb62cc6258e7631b155cda7e2d) .


**About Agenus**


Agenus is a leading immuno-oncology company targeting cancer with a comprehensive pipeline of immunological agents. The company was founded in 1994 with a mission to expand patient populations benefiting from cancer immunotherapy through combination approaches, using a broad repertoire of antibody therapeutics, adoptive cell therapies (through MiNK Therapeutics) and adjuvants. Agenus has robust end-to-end development capabilities, across commercial and clinical cGMP manufacturing facilities, research and discovery, and a global clinical operations footprint. Agenus is headquartered in Lexington, MA. For more information, visit[www.agenusbio.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.agenusbio.com&esheet=54591903&newsitemid=20260831875608&lan=en-US&anchor=www.agenusbio.com&index=3&md5=d95a7a0843abab9d914958eb8b181ab8) or @agenus_bio. Information that may be important to investors will be routinely posted on our website and social media channels.
